attchmntText: Nupur Recyclers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026 ".
voiceSummary: Nupur Recyclers Limited filed a press release regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a Profit After Tax of 879.84 Lakh for Q2 FY27, representing a year-on-year growth of 103.06%. Total revenue for the quarter stood at 11,620.80 Lakh, up 124.86% year-on-year. EBITDA reached 1,572.95 Lakh, with a margin of 13.54%. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total revenue was 19,923.85 Lakh, and Profit After Tax was 1,618.41 Lakh. The company is constructing a 6,000 MTPA Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery Recycling facility in Sampla, Haryana, with an investment of 50 to 70 Crores. Commissioning of this facility is targeted for Q4 FY27.

attchmntText: Nupur Recyclers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nupur Recyclers Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 879.84 Lacs, with revenue from operations at Rs. 11,156.58 Lacs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 11.6 basic and Rs. 11.8 diluted. Total assets were Rs. 24,729.70 Lacs. The board meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 04:00 P.M. The results are subject to publication in Jansatta and Financial Express.

attchmntText: Nupur Recyclers Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Nupur Recyclers Limited has scheduled an Earnings Conference Call for Monday, 16th November 2026, at 02:00 PM IST to discuss the financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call will be hosted via audio conference from Mumbai. Mr. Rajesh Gupta, Managing Director, will participate. The discussion will be based on publicly available information, and no unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be disclosed. Participants are requested to pre-register using the provided link and dial in five minutes in advance. The event is subject to change due to exigencies.
